content: If the use of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, the dose of encorafenib should be reduced to one-third of the original dose (e.g., from 450 mg/day to 150 mg/day). After discontinuing the inhibitor for 3-5 elimination half-lives, the previous encorafenib dose can be resumed. Etravirine decreases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF reduces the levels or effects of fexinidazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Conversely, fexinidazole increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting CYP3A4, which may increase the risk of adverse effects. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of futibatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Combining futibatinib with dual P-gp and strong CYP3A inhibitors may increase the risk of futibatinib toxicities. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of glasdegib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Consider alternative therapies that are not strong CYP3A inhibitors or monitor for increased risk of adverse effects, including QTc interval prolongation. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of ibrutinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor must be used short-term (e.g., anti-infectives for ≤7 days), interrupt ibrutinib therapy until the inhibitor is discontinued. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of idelalisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A inhibitors is necessary, monitor for signs of idelalisib toxicity and adjust the dosage as needed. Idelalisib also increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Indinavir increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Itraconazole increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of ketamine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of lefamulin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining lefamulin with strong CYP3A inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of lemborexant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining lemborexant with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of leniolisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Lopinavir increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Lorlatinib decreases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF and lovotibeglogene autotemcel: Discontinue antiretrovirals (ARTs) at least one month before mobilization and until all apheresis cycles are completed. Some long-acting ARTs may require a longer discontinuation period for elimination. ARTs may interfere with lovotibeglogene autotemcel manufacturing. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of lurbinectedin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the lurbinectedin dose by 50%. After discontinuing the strong CYP3A inhibitor for 5 half-lives, increase lurbinectedin to the pre-coadministration dose. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of macitentan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining macitentan with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of metoprolol by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of midostaurin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors cannot be avoided, monitor midostaurin for increased risk of adverse reactions, especially during the first week of treatment. Mifepristone increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of nefazodone by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of nirogacestat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of nortriptyline by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of olaparib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A inhibitors cannot be avoided, reduce the olaparib dose to 150 mg (capsule) or 100 mg (tablet) twice daily. Do not substitute tablets with capsules. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of omaveloxolone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the omaveloxolone dose to 50 mg/day. Monitor closely and discontinue if adverse effects emerge. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of osimertinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If no alternative exists, monitor the patient closely for adverse effects. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of palbociclib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose to 75 mg/day. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of palovarotene by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of pimavanserin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Reduce the pimavanserin dose to 17 mg/day if coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of pirtobrutinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the pirtobrutinib dose by 50 mg. If the current dose is 50 mg daily, discontinue pirtobrutinib during the use of the strong CYP3A inhibitor. After discontinuing the inhibitor for 5 half-lives, resume pirtobrutinib at the pre-coadministration dose. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of pomalidomide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of ponatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the ponatinib starting dose to 30 mg daily. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of pralsetinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of quetiapine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, reduce the quetiapine dose to one-sixth of the current dose. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Discontinue strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors and wait 3-5 elimination half-lives before initiating repotrectinib. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of resmetirom by affecting OATP1B1/3 transporters. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining resmetirom with OATP1B1/3 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of ribociclib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be coadministered, reduce the ribociclib starting dose to 400 mg/day. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of riociguat by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Monitor for signs of hypotension and reduce the dose if needed. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of siponimod by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining siponimod with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors plus moderate or strong CYP2C9 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of sonidegib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of sparsentan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, interrupt sparsentan treatment. When resuming sparsentan, consider dose titration. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of suvorexant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Suvorexant is not recommended with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining tazemetostat with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of vincristine liposomal by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of vorapaxar by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Voriconazole increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of abemaciclib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increase plasma levels of abemaciclib and its metabolites. Dose reduction is required. If the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, increase abemaciclib to the dose prior to initiating the strong inhibitor. Acyclovir and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Toxicity may result from coadministration of emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs that are also primarily excreted by glomerular filtration and/or active tubular secretion. Adefovir and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of alfentanil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of alprazolam by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, may require benzodiazepine dose reduction. Aluminum hydroxide decreases the levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Separate administration from antacids by 2 hours. Aluminum hydroxide/magnesium carbonate decreases the levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Separate administration from antacids by 2 hours. Aluminum hydroxide/magnesium trisilicate decreases the levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Separate administration from antacids by 2 hours. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the effects of ambrisentan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Amikacin and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the effects of amiodarone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of amitriptyline by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of amlodipine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of amoxapine by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Amphotericin B cholesteryl sulfate and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Amphotericin B deoxycholate and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Amphotericin B liposomal and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Amphotericin B phospholipid complex and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of apalutamide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration of apalutamide with strong CYP3A4 or CYP2C8 inhibitors does not require initial dosage modification; however, dose reduction may be needed based on tolerability. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of aprepitant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of aripiprazole by altering CYP2E1 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF also increases the levels of aripiprazole by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of armodafinil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF and aspirin: Either drug increases the toxicity of the other by decreasing renal clearance. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Toxicity may result from coadministration of emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs that are also primarily excreted by glomerular filtration and/or active tubular secretion, including high-dose or multiple-dose NSAIDs; alternatives to NSAIDs should be considered. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF and aspirin rectal: Either drug increases the toxicity of the other by decreasing renal clearance. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Toxicity may result from coadministration of emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs that are also primarily excreted by glomerular filtration and/or active tubular secretion, including high-dose or multiple-dose NSAIDs; alternatives to NSAIDs should be considered. Aspirin/citric acid/sodium bicarbonate decreases the levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Separate administration from antacids by 2 hours. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels or effects of atogepant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. The recommended atogepant dosage is 10 mg orally once daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of atomoxetine by altering CYP2D6 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of atorvastatin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, requires initiating atorvastatin with the lowest starting dose and titrating carefully while monitoring for safety. Do not exceed an atorvastatin dose of 20 mg/day. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of axitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events. Bacitracin and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF both increase nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Belzutifan decreases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. If coadministration of belzutifan with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates cannot be avoided, consider increasing the sensitive CYP3A4 substrate dose in accordance with its prescribing information. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase hydrocodone (benzhydrocodone is a prodrug of hydrocodone) plasma concentrations and can result in potentially fatal respiratory depression. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of benzphetamine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates where elevated plasma concentrations are associated with serious or life-threatening events.
